C0067.title: Shenzhen Cracks Down on Health and Wellness 'Pseudo-Science' Marketing Accounts
keywords: health and wellness pseudo-science marketing accounts
C0067.summary: In the Qinglang special campaigns, Shenzhen cyberspace authorities penalized a batch of violating accounts. Among them, accounts such as 'Kankan Yangsheng' and 'Jiankang Bingfa' spread pseudo-scientific health and wellness content in the short-video domain, engaging in exaggerated claims and marketing in violation of regulations, misleading the public, and were subjected to traffic restrictions, suspension, or closure.

references.title: Shenzhen reports typical enforcement cases from the Qinglang special campaigns
